company.name: Skype
company.shortDescription: Skype provides a telecommunications platform that offers free video chat and voice calls to internet-connected devices.
company.description:
Skype provides internet-based communication software that enables users to conduct voice calls, video calls, and instant messaging across computers and mobile devices. The platform allows individuals and organizations to connect through one-to-one or group conversations, share files, and display screens during calls for collaboration or support activities. It operates through user accounts that synchronize contacts, chat histories, and call records across multiple devices.

The software also supports calling from the application to traditional telephone numbers through paid calling services and provides voicemail and call forwarding capabilities. Additional functions include meeting links, message reactions, and media sharing within chat conversations. Through these tools, the platform facilitates personal communication, remote collaboration, and cross-device messaging over internet connections.
